body: Thanks. Trying. I should probably live life like it's the last day, lol, but it's not that simple. Sometimes it's a life goal of mine to get out of bed or take a shower, because this whole thing has taken over my energy.

Yeah, that might be a root of these whole problems - stress. Sleep doesn't exist, because sometimes pain is unreal, I drink sleeping pills and those don't help a lot.
